    n, m = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    result = []
    current_char = 'A'
    for i in range(n):
        row = []
        for j in range(m):
            if j < min(n - i, m):
                row.append(current_char)
            else:
                current_char = chr(ord(current_char) + 1)
                row.append(current_char)
            if (j + 1 - i) % min(n - i, m) == 0:
                current_char = chr(ord(current_char) + 1)
        result.append(''.join(row))
    for row in result:
        print(row)
